title: CS daily scratchpad — QBRs & renewals (2026-06-25)
content:
TODAY (2026-06-25) - quick hit list

Morning focus:
- Finalize QBR deck bullets for Shoreline (account A) — need updated latency & cost numbers from infra (asked Ryan)
- Renewal check-in for Meridian (annual renewal 2026-07-10) — confirm seats and billing contact
- Push follow-ups for open support tickets >72h (see list below)

Top accounts to touch today:
1) Shoreline (SaaS) — QBR prep
   - P0: include 95th pct latency for last 30d (console->models->redwood-small -> latency chart). Ryan to confirm if we should include p50 too.
   - P1: show cost per 1k tokens after caching changes — ask billing for last invoice breakdown (JIRA-CS-1423).
   - Slides: 2 intro slides + 1 ops/infra slide + 1 roadmap ask slide. Draft bullets below.
   - Action: schedule 30m dry-run with Samir and Noah on Thursday 6/27. (Noah to run infra numbers)

2) Meridian (enterprise) — renewal
   - Renewal date: 2026-07-10 (renewal window opens 2026-06-20). Confirm decision-maker: Sarah Liu (finance), technical: DevOps lead Mark Huang.
   - Current commit: Dedicated small pool (4 GPUs), monthly. Upsell opportunity: add spike burst for holiday campaign + 12-month discount.
   - Action: Send renewal email template + proposed SKUs by EOD 6/26. Add note: include 5% discount if commit signed by 6/30.

3) Atlas Health — support & SLA
   - Open ticket #3421: intermittent tokenization mismatch in private deployment. Engineering assigned (ticket owner: Priya). Waiting on reproducible case from customer.
   - Follow-up: ask eng to escalate if no repro by EOD tomorrow. Offer to run additional logs from their private VPC (requires customer approval).

Support follow-ups (tickets >72h):
- TKT-3408 (Atlas Health) — waiting on customer repro (sent template).
- TKT-3412 (ShopLoop) — model drift reported on reranker; assigned to applied-ml. Need ETA for retrain/patch.
- TKT-3399 (BlueCart) — billing discrepancy; finance looped in (Noah). Confirmed partial refund processed 6/23; need final confirmation.

Meeting prep notes (QBR template reminders):
- 1 slide: "health snapshot" (uptime, errors, latency trends) — keep concisely 3 metrics
- 1 slide: "cost & usage" (token mix, caching impact, per-route cost)
- 1 slide: "what we shipped" (last quarter infra/optimizations + impact)
- 1 slide: "roadmap & asks" (capacity, model variants, SLAs)
- Appendix: logs, open tickets, action owners

Quick todos (time-box 2h this morning):
- [ ] Pull 30d latency numbers for Shoreline (ask Ryan)
- [ ] Draft Meridian renewal email + attach current invoice
- [ ] Ping Priya (eng) for Atlas Health ticket status
- [ ] Update QBR deck skeleton and share w/ Samir
- [ ] Triage support queue: close tickets that are resolved but not confirmed by customers

Notes to self / reminders:
- Use the new QBR template from Confluence (CONFLUENCE-6789) — slide order changed slightly.
- Keep language customer-friendly: avoid "rate limit" jargon, use "throughput management" or "capacity plan".
- For renewals, loop in Solutions Eng early if customer's infra is complex.

Draft email snippet (Meridian renewal):
"Hi Sarah — hope you're well. We're approaching Meridian's annual renewal on July 10. Attached is a proposed commitment that adds burst capacity for campaign spikes and maintains your current latency SLAs. If you'd like, we can schedule a short call next week to walk through options and timelines. Best, Aisha"

Open questions / blockers:
- Ryan: can you confirm 95th pct latency for redwood-small over last 30d by 12pm?
- Priya (eng): any ETA on reproducing Atlas Health tokenization issue?
- Finance: can billing send a detailed invoice breakdown for Shoreline (6/1-6/24)?

Links & refs:
- QBR template: drive:shared_drives/product/qbr-template
- Meridian billing: drive:shared_drives/finance/meridian-invoices/2026-Q2.pdf
- Relevant tickets: JIRA-CS-1423, TKT-3408, TKT-3412

End-of-day quick review:
- Did I get numbers for Shoreline? (Y/N)
- Meridian email sent? (Y/N)
- All >72h tickets either updated or escalated? (Y/N)

-- Aisha
(quick log: synced w/ Samir 2026-06-24 about QBR outline; Samir wants more focus on reliability wins)
